brief:
Settlers stormed the edges of al-Mugheir and Deir Jarir villages in Ramallah and al-Bireh governorate on Monday evening, the Shehab Wire reported. The two communities lie in the northern section of the occupied West Bank.

The incursion represented the latest in recurring raids by Israeli settlers on Palestinian villages across the territory. Such operations have intensified in recent months, drawing condemnation from Palestinian officials and international observers who view them as part of a broader campaign to pressure Palestinians from their lands.
